title: MiniMax H3 — Video + Audio
description: MiniMax H3 on ComfyUI (CUDA 13): text / image / first-last-frame / reference-to-video with audio. Two template sets — native (core nodes + URL loaders) and enhancers (prompt enhancer, RIFE interpolation, TensorRT upscaling). Models download to the network volume on first boot.
